metadata.case_name: LO YUEN CHONG v. IWS ENVIRONMENTAL TECHNOLOGIES LTD (FORMERLY KNOWN AS FOOK WOO ENVIRONMENTAL TECHNOLOGIES)

injuries.description: Xray of the left wrist showed fracture of the left distal radius, with dislocation of the distal ulnar radial joint.
source: Xray of the left wrist showed fracture of the left distal radius, with dislocation of the distal ulnar radial joint.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of wrist

injuries.description: The Plaintiff was suffering from a mild dorm of carpal tunnel syndrome;
source: The Plaintiff was suffering from a mild dorm of carpal tunnel syndrome;
injuries.icd_description: Injury of median nerve at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: 2 scars (35 mm and 20 mm respectively) are left causing much discomfort.
source: 2 scars (35 mm and 20 mm respectively) are left causing much discomfort.

manifestations.description: Residual on and off pain in her left wrist

Left wrist extension and flexion mobility, supination and pronation mobility were all increased to full range of movement (after physiotherapy) but there remained a slight lag in radial and ulnar deviation
Left hand grip is weaker than the right side (grip strength recorded as 15kg after physiotherapy; later assessment right/left hand = 34/25 kgf)
Left wrist was deformed with tenderness and swelling (on initial examination)
Discomfort caused by scars on the left wrist

treatments_received: Open reduction and internal fixation performed on 10 January 2013
Occupational therapy (functional training, mobilization, edema control, scar management and strengthening programs)
treatments_future: No further treatment or surgery is necessary

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Loss of enjoyment and reduced ability to engage in hobbies of fishing and embroidery

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty carrying boxes of A4 paper and inability to carry heavy items for long periods affecting work/domestic tasks
Discomfort and consequences of two scars on the left wrist (35 mm and 20 mm)
Weaker left hand grip and mild limitation in radial and ulnar deviation affecting wrist function

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Nga Yin formerly known as Chan Mei Yi, Sicely v. MTR Corporation Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture of her left distal radius; underwent open reduction and internal fixation; mild limitation of range of movement of her left wrist
